_source: Forge-C factory/checklists/v0.4/SWE.4.yaml and the inherited v0.3 factory/release-manager/checklists/SWE.4.yaml, neutralised for feature 023

items.title: Verification strategy defined
items.pass_criterion: Unit verification measures, environment, entry/exit criteria and regression approach are defined.
items.typical_defect: Tests exist but no stated environment, exit criterion or regression approach.

items.title: Test cases adequate
items.pass_criterion: Every unit has appropriate positive, negative, boundary and error test cases derived from its unit specification.
items.typical_defect: Only nominal-path tests; invalid-argument and boundary values untested.

items.title: Test double fidelity
items.pass_criterion: Mocks, stubs and simulated hardware are assessed for fidelity to the real register semantics and hardware side effects; known limitations are recorded.
items.typical_defect: Mock register ignores write-1-to-clear semantics, so a defect passes the test.

items.title: Static-analysis and coding-rule gaps reviewed
items.pass_criterion: Static-analysis and coding-rule findings not resolved in the code receive a review or a recorded deviation.
items.typical_defect: Open analysis findings with neither fix nor deviation record.

items.title: Structural coverage linked to results
items.pass_criterion: Coverage goals are defined for the applicable rigor level, and structural coverage reports come from the actual executed results; uncovered code is justified.
items.typical_defect: Coverage figure quoted without a report from the executed run.

items.title: Unit-spec coverage by passing tests
items.pass_criterion: Every unit test case declares the unit-spec items it verifies, and every unit-spec item is verified by at least one executed, passing unit test.
items.typical_defect: Unit-spec item with no test, or a test that declares no verified item.

items.title: Reproducible results and findings
items.pass_criterion: Unit/design/test/result traceability is complete, logs reproduce the results (content-identified), and findings are recorded and summarised.
items.typical_defect: Pass verdict with no log, or results that cannot be tied to the tested code version.
